legend: The Nain Rouge, the Red Dwarf of Detroit (Michigan, USA, French colonial legend, 1701)
lines: Detroit, 1701. A little red creature waits in the dark.
It has glowing eyes, wolf fur and a wicked grin.
It is the Nain Rouge, the red dwarf of the French settlers.
Cadillac, the founder, struck at it with his cane.
The dwarf laughed, and legend says he cursed the city on the spot.
Later, people claimed to see him dancing before fires and storms.
They say he appeared before the great fire of 1805.
Today, Detroit marches every spring to chase him out of town.
Would you dare to meet his eyes tonight?
title: The Red Dwarf Who Cursed Detroit Before It Even Began #shorts
description:
In Detroit legend, a little red dwarf called the Nain Rouge cursed the city in 1701 and appears before disasters. Every spring the city marches to chase him away.
